name: ElevenLabs
description: ElevenLabs is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: ElevenLabs is a privately held artificial intelligence company focused on voice and audio. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $500 million Series D round announced on February 4, 2026, valued the company at $11 billion.

Founded in 2022 and based in New York, ElevenLabs develops AI models that generate speech, music and sound effects, along with a platform on which businesses build voice agents. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Special purpose vehicles with SEC filings naming ElevenLabs
table_note: The Series D and Series C valuations are as announced by the company; the Series B valuation is as reported by Bloomberg, and the Series A valuation as reported by TechCrunch.
round_notes: ElevenLabs has said it ended 2025 with more than $330 million of annual recurring revenue. In September 2026, the company said it had completed a $300 million employee tender offer, led by Wellington and T. Rowe Price, that valued it at $22 billion.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Sequoia Capital led the Series D, Andreessen Horowitz and ICONIQ Growth co-led the Series C, and Andreessen Horowitz, Nat Friedman and Daniel Gross co-led the Series B and the Series A. Other investors include Lightspeed Venture Partners, BOND, Salesforce Ventures, Smash Capital, BroadLight Capital and Deutsche Telekom.
spv_sentence: Three special purpose vehicles formed to invest in ElevenLabs have filed with the SEC, all of them in 2026.
sources: Sources: ElevenLabs announcements of its employee tender offer (September 2026), Series D (February 2026), Series C (January 2025) and Series B (January 2024); reports by TechCrunch (September 2026 and June 2023) and Bloomberg (January 2024); and SEC Form D filings.
